subject: [RFC PATCH 18/18] mm/filemap: add a debugfs switch for lockless page cache reads

2026-10-19.patch_summary: This patch adds a debugfs switch called 'lockless_page_cache_read' that allows users to toggle lockless page cache reads on or off. When enabled, this feature defers the freeing of memory for hot pages by an RCU grace period, allowing for faster reads but potentially leading to memory leaks if not used carefully. The patch also includes a static key to keep the test off the read path and provides a way to turn off lockless page cache reads in case of issues or workloads that lose on this trade-off.
